Each data row creates a new product with its starting stock. Existing products are never overwritten.
Required fields are marked with *. Use plain numbers for purchase quantities and prices.
New category names in the Category column are created in the selected store during import.
Base Unit is what customers buy, such as piece, bottle, or kg. Purchase Unit is how the vendor sells it, such as tie, tray, or sack.
Enter the number of base units inside one purchase unit and how many purchase units were bought.
Starting stock and cost per base unit are calculated from package quantity, units per package, and total purchase price.
Leave optional stock thresholds blank to use 0. Lead Time Days defaults to 1.
Existing SKUs in this store and duplicate SKUs in this file will be skipped.
No saved categories yet. New category names entered on Products are created in the selected store during import.
Sample inventory for testing. Prices are in PHP. Purchase costs are illustrative wholesale estimates, not supplier quotations. Replace them with actual invoices before using this as live inventory.
Retail price examples reference Puregold listings for Lucky Me! Pancit Canton, Mega Sardines, Coca-Cola 1.5 L, and Century Tuna. Prices vary by location and date.
Lucky Me! Pancit Canton Original 80 g: https://puregold.com.ph/pgcatalog/product/view/title/LUCKY%20ME%21%20PANCIT%20CANTON%20ORIGINAL%2080G%20/barcode/4807770273704
Beer case price references: https://shotify.ph/collections/beer and https://buy.coop/products/san-miguel-beer-pale-pilsen-can-330ml-x24-case-ayhxj
PSA selected agricultural commodity price situationer, including rice: https://psa.gov.ph/statistics/price-situationer/selected-agri-commodities/index
Optional Selling Options sheet: one row per bundle, linked to Products by SKU. These selling options are imported with each product.
Purchase Options sheet: one row per supplier package, linked by SKU. For eggs, you can select purchase by the piece (1 base unit) or by tray (30 base units).
The sample egg cost is an illustrative estimate. The PHP 9.50 piece price and PHP 270 tray price are example retail prices; local prices vary by size and market.

Egg price reference: Guimaras January 2026 average retail was PHP 9.50 per medium egg: https://rsso06.psa.gov.ph/sites/default/files/article/SR2026-64-Price%20Situationer%20of%20Meat%20and%20Poultry%20in%20Guimaras%20Second%20Phase%20of%20January%202026%20%28Reference%20Period%2015%20to%2017%20January%202026%29.pdf
